curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a mad scramble over a barrel of magic potion goes off course, how will the Gauls keep Britannia out of Roman clutches?
curatedMovie.description: When a lone British village resists Roman invaders, Asterix and Obelix arrive to help, braving rain, boiled boar, and local quirks while pushing back Governor Encyclopaedius Britannicus's legions.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, breezy, and family-friendly animated fun that asks very little heavy lifting from its audience.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Pino Van Lamsweerde delivers a cheerful, briskly paced animated adventure filled with classic comic slapstick and playful cultural ribbing.
